description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 3 turns left onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 4 is oncoming relative to Vehicle 1 and goes straight through the intersection. On Vehicle 1's exit road, cones are arranged across the lane width leaving only the left edge passable, followed by a parked truck partially blocking the right edge.
